subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Should the session-accessor reroute and the provider/auth/failover hardening batch be accepted as the final scope of this tracker?
rationale: Both residuals are confirmed on current main, but their permanent session and plugin/provider boundaries are compatibility-sensitive and the issue carries an explicit protected maintainer signal.

options.title: Finish Both Residuals
options.body: Review and land both focused PRs, then close the tracker as complete.

options.title: Narrow Final Scope
options.body: Accept one residual and document why the other duplicate path remains an intentional owner.

options.title: Retire Remaining Work
options.body: Close both linked PRs and the tracker with a maintainer rationale that further core churn outweighs the confirmed drift risk.

recommendation.title: Finish Both Residuals
recommendation.body: Review and land both focused PRs, then close the tracker as complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the strongest cross-seam implementation and re-verification context for presenting the final decomposition, while repository maintainers retain final authority.
